text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I hold within me a quiet resolve.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A resolve to push through every trial and 
tribulation, 
until this body of mine can pierce even 
solid stone—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was a child, I have loved to 
run.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I had older cousins with whom I was 
close. I would 
lose myself in the footraces I ran with 
them.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"*Pant*, *pant*... Hehehe! 
Alright, first place! Did you see that?!"

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
"*Gasp*, *pant*... Ahaha! You're so 
amazing! 
Big Sis is incredible, isn't she, 
Phalaeno-chan?!"

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... What are you saying? Brian 
too... 
Both of you sisters are remarkably fast.

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Right, special training. With that, I 
will defeat 
both of you. —Wash your necks and wait for 
me!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I possessed hope. On the turf, 
running freer than anyone—faster than any 
other, 
I never doubted that future for a single 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Pant, pant... Ngh. Why...? Why 
won't you move for me...?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Running trapped heat within me, leaving me 
unable to even eat. 
In my youth, I learned the bitter agony of 
a body unable to match the heart.

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Phalaenopsis, what purpose do these 
legs serve? 
If you cannot run, what kind of horsegirl 
are you?

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I know my body isn't suited for this. But 
even so—... Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...It was a burden far too heavy for a 
young child 
to bear alone. Had things continued like 
that, I surely 
would have withered away before ever 
sprouting.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet, there was hope. There were those 
who reached out and lifted me from 
despair.

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno-san! How are you feeling? 
Don't push yourself, let's take it one 
step at a time!

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Please let me take on 
any kind of training.

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're such a hard worker, 
Phaleno-san. 
—I'm sure you'll be able to run much 
better soon.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...It was an irreplaceable bond. The joy 
they brought me was beyond words.

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A massage... 
You always do this before training...

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Your muscles tend to stiffen 
up easily, Phaleno-san, so we have to make 
sure 
to loosen them up first!

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Were you able to eat breakfast today? 
If not yet, we have light snacks, so 
please help yourself!

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah—

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Due to your condition of inverted body 
temperature, 
you tend to have trouble regulating heat, 
Phaleno-san. 
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
On days when it's too hot, training 
indoors 
is best! Along the inner wall track, 
300 laps to go! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah— 
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: It doesn't hurt... as much as usual...?

text_block_list.name: Young Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I can run? Even someone like me... 
...Haha. I see. If it's here—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It was there that my future was handed to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever forget those days? 
How could I ever fail to repay that debt 
of gratitude?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I owe a "gratitude" to the Club that 
a lifetime 
could never fully repay. Which is 
precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I shall make our Club into the most 
beautiful garden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
None other than I, the one saved by the 
Club, 
shall accomplish it. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This is no lukewarm spark like some mere 
dream 
one wishes would come true.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is my lifelong ambition, worthy of 
staking my very life upon.

With my contract with Phalaenopsis 
finalized, 
today marks our first official day of 
training together.

I got a bit too eager and arrived at the 
track 
thirty minutes early... 
Yet she was already there.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
(...Is she meditating? I'd hate to disturb 
her...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —You are welcome to speak to me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to be so hesitant. 
You are my Trainer, after all.
choice_data_list:
Still, it looked like important 
preparation.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Heh, I see... An admirable mindset.
choice_data_list: I am your apprentice, after all.
After all, I'm your disciple as well.

text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis was my trainee, but she was 
also 
a mentor to me, someone from whom I 
learned.

Back when I was still green, I lived in 
fear 
of holding an Umamusume's future in my 
hands...

It was then that I met her. A noble moth 
orchid, 
overflowing with gratitude to the club 
that stood by 
her despite her fragile constitution—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The most beautiful garden. It may be too 
grand a future 
for someone as frail as I to envision.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet my mind is made up. 
—Never shall I fear, nor shall I falter.

Spending time with Phalaenopsis made me 
realize 
what I was lacking: the unyielding resolve 
she possessed 
toward the goals she had set for herself.

The resolve to press on, fully aware of 
her frail body. 
The will to swallow her anxieties and face 
the future.

That essential quality every Trainer 
needed was missing in me. 
And so, in order to attain it—

I asked to become her disciple. I believed 
there was 
much to learn from the way she carried 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Let us begin with our usual 
check.
choice_data_list: Right. I've got the checklist ready.
Yeah. I have the checklist right here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Most thorough of you. 
Let us put it to good use.

—Phalaenopsis possessed a peculiar 
physical condition: 
an "inverted body temperature rhythm."

Her temperature rises in the morning and 
drops in the afternoon, 
making it difficult for her body to 
regulate heat.

That is why a meticulous health check 
before training 
is indispensable. As for today...
choice_data_list: Yeah. Everything looks fine.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, let us begin. 
Assign the regimen you have prepared.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaahhhhhh!!!
choice_data_list: Your pace is dropping! Maintain it!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa, haa...
choice_data_list:
(...Is ten sets really pushing it too 
far...?!)

text_block_list.text:
Past the seventh shuttle sprint, 
her breathing began to falter. Just as I 
was agonizing 
over whether I had made the regimen too 
harsh...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Continue.
choice_data_list: ...! Ninth run! Go!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... 
Haaahhhhhhhhh!!
choice_data_list:
(...Fierce. So grueling it makes me want 
to stop her.)

text_block_list.text:
Her training was always like this. 
Since her body could not easily keep up, 
she constantly 
had to push the absolute limits of her 
physical endurance.

Her condition had been relatively good 
today. 
I thought she might just reach her target, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! 
...Ngh... So that is how it is...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Frustrating though it is... Trainer.
choice_data_list: Understood. That's enough for today.
Got it. That's all for today.

text_block_list.text:
With just one run left to complete the 
training, 
we called it off. Grabbing a drink, 
I ushered her into the shade.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Things rarely go as one hopes, it 
seems.
choice_data_list: Even so, you're doing remarkably well.
Even so, you did great out there.

text_block_list.text:
Struggling with such physical frailties... 
how many Umamusume could push themselves 
to the brink 
and hone their abilities for a single 
purpose like this?

What shone through was an ironclad 
resolve, 
and a profound sense of gratitude to her 
club.
choice_data_list: (She truly commands respect... and yet...)

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but look inward. 
Am I truly making the right decisions for 
someone like her?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...What is the matter? You wear such a 
pensive expression.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Are you troubled by something? 
Regarding the path we walk together.
choice_data_list: N-No! I'm not troubled, not really—

text_block_list.text:
It would be a lie to say I wasn't. 
...Watching her earlier 
training, I couldn't help but feel 
anxious.
choice_data_list: ...I was worried it might be too harsh.

text_block_list.text:
This is only our starting point. If we 
continue to push ourselves 
at this pace going forward...
choice_data_list:
I felt that someday, it might become "too 
severe"...

text_block_list.text:
Were we rushing ahead too fast for our 
goal? 
When considering the future of her racing 
career, I couldn't 
shake the doubt that we ought to be more 
cautious.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I understand your concern. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Watch from here.
choice_data_list: Huh...? Phaleno...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!
choice_data_list:
What?! W-Why are you running another 
one...?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*, *haah*... Having rested, I had 
strength 
to spare. So I poured it into the turf.
choice_data_list:
T-To push yourself to the absolute brink 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do not be overly afraid of feeding the 
present to the flames.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Our purpose is one and only: a magnificent 
garden. 
To protect that future, caution is indeed 
well and good.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Rather, you are right to be that way. Only 
with such a perspective 
can we seize certain futures to come.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet, for the sake of the future we must 
grasp, 
there are times when we must set today 
ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: That is the path we have chosen.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
With full understanding of that, we 
entered into our contract. 
...Was it not so for you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
When I asked if you had the resolve to 
walk into the future with me... 
was your answer nothing more than an 
illusion?

Phalaenopsis's question brings back the 
memory. 
That's right, after seeing through the 
selection race—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared to advance into the 
future—with me?

If I nodded to that question... then I had 
to have the resolve 
to walk even a path of thorns together 
with her.
choice_data_list:
...I'm sorry for hesitating from the very 
first day.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: No, as long as you understand, it is fine.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...However, Trainer. 
Are those the only words you have to say?

Hearing that, I quietly shake my head. 
Looking back into her eyes, I speak.
choice_data_list:
Allow me to accompany you. All the way to 
that brilliant future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, very well. 
Come.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We shall witness the supreme view 
together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As threatening snow and frosty winds blow 
harsh and chill, 
my fervent feelings only blaze more fierce 
and bright.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In harsh midwinter, frosty winds howl. And 
for that very reason, 
the fire within this body blazes all the 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I shall surely reward your devotion.
